title: Repair misplaced service reports
task: Two reports were saved in the wrong place. Move services/api/api-owner.txt to api-owner.txt at lab/. Move services/worker/worker-mode.txt to worker-mode.txt at lab/. Preserve their contents and remove the misplaced originals.
hints: Use pwd and ls services/api services/worker to locate both reports. The destination is two directory levels above each source.

mv services/worker/worker-mode.txt worker-mode.txt
Then run cli-silly check.

checks.label: The API owner report is intact at the workspace root
checks.feedback: From lab/, move services/api/api-owner.txt to api-owner.txt. Check its contents with cat.

checks.label: The worker mode report is intact at the workspace root
checks.feedback: From lab/, move services/worker/worker-mode.txt to worker-mode.txt. Check its contents with cat.

checks.label: The old API report location is empty
checks.feedback: A copy leaves the source behind. Use mv, or remove the old source after verifying your intact copy.

checks.label: The old worker report location is empty
checks.feedback: Confirm the report is at lab/ before removing its misplaced original.

demo.explanation: The report is nested two levels below the workspace root. A relative source path starts from your current directory.

demo.visual:
lab/
├── services/web/       now empty
└── version.txt         moved intact
demo.explanation: mv takes the source first and destination second. From lab/, version.txt names a file at the root.
Inspect both the destination contents and the old location. A successful move preserves the text and removes the old path.
